goal: Frisson 1.0 Phase 2: user profiles. Users get bio, optional location, avatar (square JPEG via the same sharp pipeline as covers, stored under DATA_DIR/avatars), up to 6 social links in a separate ordered table, and an admin-only verified flag. API: GET /api/users/:username (public), PATCH /api/me/profile, POST/DELETE /api/me/avatar, PATCH /api/users/:username/verified (admin). Web: /u/:username public profile page, Edit profile page, header menu link to own profile, crate pages show owner name linking to the profile.
constraints: Never rename or move crate.db, DATA_DIR, /data or the crate-data volume.

Additive migration only, generated with drizzle-kit (npm run db:generate -w apps/api) as 0004; never edit existing files in apps/api/drizzle (0000-0003 SQL or snapshots) and do not hand-edit the new migration. Existing users get empty profiles through column defaults (bio '', location NULL, avatar NULL, verified 0).
Existing data (users, sessions, crates, albums, tracks) must survive the migration, proven by a test in the style of apps/api/test/migration.test.ts.
Parameterized queries only (Drizzle builder or bound params); no string-built SQL.
No secrets in source; all errors via HttpError and the existing error-handler plugin.

Reuse the covers approach: sharp (already a dependency) re-encodes to square JPEG, random file names, basename-guarded deletes, @fastify/multipart limits, @fastify/static with immutable caching. No new dependency. If one proves unavoidable: npm_config_nodedir=/opt/node22 npm install, and report its license.
Never expose email, role, password hash or session data in any public response; the public profile shape is a dedicated zod schema in packages/shared.
Only admins may set verified. PATCH /api/me/profile must not accept or apply verified, role, email or username (unknown keys stripped or rejected), so a user cannot self-verify.
Profile text (display name, bio, location, link urls) is rendered as plain text via {{ }} bindings, never v-html. Links use target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer".
Link urls must parse with the URL class, use protocol https:, and be at most 2048 chars; javascript:, data:, http: are rejected.
Out of scope: favorites, likes, follows, feed, B-Side, email verification, password change, account deletion.
format:check, lint, typecheck, vitest (api and web) and build stay green.
Do not touch the Pennant GitHub organization.
assumptions: Public profile is anonymous-readable (no login needed); GET /api/users/:username 404s for unknown usernames, lookup is case-insensitive via lower-casing, and uses the same username charset as signup so /u/:username needs no escaping.
bio max 500 chars, default empty string; location optional (null when empty) max 80; displayName keeps the existing 1-60 rule; all values trimmed.

PATCH /api/me/profile is a full replacement of the editable fields (displayName, bio, location, links) with links as the complete ordered list (0-6); order in the array becomes position 0..n-1; replacement happens in one transaction. Sending the same platform twice is allowed (e.g. two websites) unless the planner decides otherwise.
PATCH /api/users/:username/verified takes body {verified: boolean}, returns the public profile, and returns 401 signed out, 403 for non-admins (including on their own username), 404 unknown user.

Avatar upload uses multipart field name 'avatar', max 5 MB (MAX_AVATAR_BYTES in shared), output 400x400 JPEG, same 50 MP input-pixel guard as covers; non-image bytes give 400; oversize gives 413. Stored as /avatars/<userId>-<8 hex>.jpg under DATA_DIR/avatars (AVATARS_DIR env override, default beside covers); the DB stores only the URL path; replacing or removing deletes the old file; DELETE with no avatar is a 200 no-op.

Avatar URL prefix is /avatars/; web plugin SPA fallback must exclude /avatars/ so missing avatar files 404 instead of returning index.html. dev proxy in apps/web/vite.config.ts and any Caddy/compose config get /avatars if /covers is proxied there.
GET /api/auth/me and signup/login responses (publicUser, private) gain avatarUrl and verified so the header can show them; email and role stay only in that private shape.

Crate responses already carry ownerUsername; crate pages link it to /u/:username. Owner display name is added to the crate schema only if needed for display (optional ownerDisplayName, nullable); NULL-owner crates show no owner link.
The public profile lists the user's crates (id, name, color, label, album count), all crates being public as today.
Verified badge is a text/SVG badge with an accessible label 'Verified', shown next to the display name on the profile page and in the header menu; elsewhere optional.
Backups: avatars are plain files like covers; docs/DEPLOY.md backup and restore notes and db/backup.ts, db/restore.ts console hints mention the avatars folder. No change to volume layout.

Existing rate limits are unchanged; avatar upload and profile PATCH need a signed-in user only. Social-link platform list lives once in packages/shared (SOCIAL_PLATFORMS) and is used by api schema, drizzle enum and web select. Platform to host matching is not enforced (any https url for any platform) unless the planner adds it.
risks: drizzle-kit ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN for SQLite needs defaults for NOT NULL columns (bio, verified); the generated 0004 must be checked to contain only additive statements. Phase 1 saw drizzle-kit drop an ON DELETE action on an added FK; the new social_links FK is on a CREATE TABLE, so check it reports ON DELETE CASCADE.

A second @fastify/multipart or static registration alongside covers could fail with duplicate decorator errors. Register multipart once (move or share it) and register a second fastifyStatic with decorateReply false for /avatars/.
SPA fallback in apps/api/src/plugins/web.ts hardcodes /api/ and /covers/; /avatars/ and /u/ interplay must be handled so /u/x serves index.html but /avatars/missing.jpg is a real 404.

Leaking private fields: reusing toPublicUser (which includes email, role) for the public profile would leak them. Needs a separate mapper and a test that asserts absence of email and role in the JSON.
Self-verify via mass assignment: tests must send verified:true to PATCH /api/me/profile and prove it is ignored or rejected.
Orphaned avatar files on failed DB writes or races between replace calls; follow the setCover try/catch cleanup pattern.
URL validation edge cases (uppercase scheme, credentials in URL, whitespace, very long values, unicode hosts); the shared zod schema must be the single source for api and web.

Existing web and api tests build PublicUser fixtures; adding fields to publicUser or crate schemas will break typecheck of fixtures (as in Phase 1); make new fields optional-with-default or update fixtures within the owning task.
Test fixtures that create users via createUser must keep working with the new columns' defaults.
Phase 1 left owner_id FK with NO ACTION in the live DB, not SET NULL; not in scope but do not rely on it.
